name: presenterm
description: Modern terminal slideshow tool for markdown presentations with themes, image support, and export capabilities

presenterm.description: Terminal slideshow tool with markdown support, themes, image protocols, PDF/HTML export, and speaker notes
presenterm.usage:
presenterm presentation.md # Start slideshow
presenterm --export-pdf presentation.md # Export to PDF
presenterm --theme dark presentation.md # Use specific theme
presenterm --list-themes # Show available themes
presenterm --present presentation.md # Presentation mode
